I checked, and go-ethereum does not use it https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/master/internal/ethapi/transaction_args.go#L478-L488 we use these rules to determine the tx type from the args but I think it should use the type if it's specified Thanks, yep we are deciding whether we should rely on this field in any sense or not. I guess it should be stay considered
